name: Tower of Ilgalar
summary: In eastern Redridge, Morganth holds the Tower of Ilgalar and commands the Shadowhide gnolls. The banished sorcerer practices dark magic there, far from Stormwind.

sections.title: A Bastion of Dark Sorcery
sections.body: Morganth holds the Tower of Ilgalar above eastern Redridge. Cast out of Stormwind's Mage Quarter for forbidden magic, the sorcerer retreated to these rugged heights to pursue the dark arts beyond imperial interference. He rules the local Shadowhide gnoll clan, whose members guard the spire's base. Inside, conjured demonic hounds stalk the tower, and shadowy power threatens Lakeshire below.

sections.title: The Rivalry with Azora
sections.body: The Tower of Ilgalar draws comparisons to the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. Who built Ilgalar remains a mystery, and the towers face one another in quiet magical opposition. In Elwynn, the archmage Theocritus watches Ilgalar through enchanted scrying devices such as the Eye of Azora. He monitors Morganth's experiments and seeks to stop the sorcerer's corruption from spreading through the kingdom.

faq.q: Who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar?
aliases: who is in tower of ilgalar
faq.answer: Morganth lives in the tower, ruling it with summoned demonic darkhounds and the local Shadowhide gnolls. The human sorcerer was exiled from Stormwind City for forbidden dark magic.

faq.q: Why did Morganth flee to Redridge?
faq.answer: Morganth fled Stormwind after the Mage Quarter cast him out for pursuing the dark arts. He withdrew to Redridge's remote crags to carry out forbidden experiments beyond the scrutiny of the realm's authorities and the Kirin Tor.

faq.q: What is the connection between this tower and the Tower of Azora?
faq.answer: The Tower of Ilgalar and the Tower of Azora are magical spires in southern Stormwind, seemingly mirrored in purpose. From Elwynn Forest, Theocritus uses the Eye of Azora to watch Ilgalar's upper sanctum and Morganth's dark rituals.

faq.q: Why are there gnolls guarding the tower?
faq.answer: Morganth used magic to subdue the local Shadowhide gnolls. They guard the tower's outer reaches and keep intruders, scouts, and the Lakeshire militia from climbing the cliffs to his sanctum.

angles.text: As a mage, the tower warns of the dangers of forbidden dark magic. Kirin Tor veterans such as Theocritus keep watch.
As a warlock, you may find Morganth's summoned darkhounds and shadowy hexes a striking example of rogue spellcraft beyond city covens.
